chapter_title_en: A Wind Rises Overseas: The Possession Art
chapter_keywords: a record of a mortal's journey to immortality
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 411: Extreme Yin Ancestor’s Possession Shakes the Cultivation World
chapter_meta_description: The conspiracy is laid bare as Wu Chou admits to hijacking the Sublime Sound Sect’s cargo, but the real terror arrives when Extreme Yin Ancestor descends via the Possession Art, turning his own grandson into a vessel.
og_title: The Demon Ancestor Rises: Wu Chou Unmasked
og_description: Wu Chou’s arrogance vanishes as a twisted Possession Art reveals the true mastermind—Extreme Yin Ancestor is here, and his disciple knows what that means.
twitter_title: The mask is off—Extreme Yin Ancestor possesses his own grandson in a terrifying display of power.
twitter_description: The real master of the conspiracy isn’t Wu Chou—it’s his grandfather, the demonic ancestor, and he’s here for the Heavenly Void Map.

lore_anchors.definition: A temporary soul-projection technique that allows a high-level cultivator to inhabit and control another’s body from a distance, projecting a fraction (often a third) of their true power.
The ancient, terrifying founder of Extreme Yin Island; a demonic cultivator of immense power known for treating his disciples as disposable tools and slaves.
A legendary ancient treasure or realm that surfaces once every three hundred years; a fragment of its map is a priceless heirloom sought by major powers.
A major demonic faction in the Chaotic Star Sea, ruled by the Extreme Yin Ancestor; known for its ruthless culture of blood sacrifices and soul-refining techniques.
A demonic sect whose name evokes concealment and killing intent; currently led by a man who is a former disciple of Extreme Yin Ancestor.
A term of address for a junior disciple of one’s master’s generation; here it reveals a secret master-disciple connection between the Hidden Kill Sect leader and the Extreme Yin Ancestor.
A cultivator's spiritual perception; allows scanning an area for hidden enemies, though high-tier concealment techniques can evade it.
A partial map leading to the legendary Heavenly Void Hall; owning even a fragment makes a cultivator a target for the most powerful forces in the world.
